doc.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Joining Basie and life on the road
title: The first cross-country tour and meeting Vivian
summary: The tour reached Los Angeles, where he met his first wife, Vivian; the marriage ended after he left Basie.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: How long was this tour, this first tour?

The tour was about three to four weeks. It took us all across the country, as far as Los Angeles. In Los Angeles we had three days, a weekend, a Friday, Saturday, Sunday at a place called the 54 Ballroom at 54th and Broadway in Los Angeles. There I met the lady who became my first wife.
I guess you said yesterday that relationship lasted roughly concurrently -- was roughly concurrent with your years with Basie.
How did that relationship end? It did end so -­

It ended after I left the Basie band, after 11 years. It was pretty stormy when I came home. I hadn’t been a very good boy. I had already met the lady who is my present wife. It’s a case of I just couldn’t hang anymore.
